title: Git Config Generator
description: Build a .gitconfig — identity, default branch, editor, aliases and core settings.
howto: Enter your name, email and preferences.

faqs.a: Save as ~/.gitconfig for your user-wide Git configuration.

faqs.q: What aliases are included by default?
faqs.a: co (checkout), br (branch), ci (commit), st (status), unstage, last and visual — edit or remove any of them.
